_note: Job A batch 2. Past-due claims from 2024-07-06 to 2024-12-31. Base rates named; corpus checked directly where the question was whether a prior telling exists.

evidence.summary: Nothing publicly identifiable occurred on or about 6 July 2024. The nearest large event in the window is the 13 July 2024 shooting at the Trump rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, one week later.
evidence.rationale: The claim is that a decade elapsed since a private 2014 experience and that we are now at the end of the runway. It names no outcome, so nothing on 6 July 2024 could have confirmed or refuted it. Recorded rather than left open, because there is no test to run.

evidence.summary: No attack occurred over the Fourth of July weekend 2024 in the United States. On 13 July 2024, nine days later, Thomas Matthew Crooks fired eight shots at a Trump rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, wounding Trump in the ear, killing attendee Corey Comperatore and critically injuring two others.
evidence.rationale: The falsifier written at extraction time reads 'an attack over the Fourth of July 2024 or an attempt on Trump', and the second branch was satisfied nine days outside the window he named. The Fourth of July half missed cleanly. Weigh also that DHS and the FBI issue heightened-threat advisories before every Fourth of July, so a call to pray over that weekend carries no information; what carries information is the Trump half, and that is scored properly under candidate-outdoor-attack, where the December telling is far more specific than this one.

evidence.summary: No terrorist attack occurred at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. On the night of 25-26 July, hours before the opening ceremony, coordinated arson destroyed cabling at three junctions on the French TGV network, disrupting travel for roughly 800,000 passengers; no group claimed responsibility and the opening ceremony went ahead. France deployed about 45,000 police for the ceremony.
evidence.rationale: This is a prayer that nothing happen, and nothing happened, which cannot be told apart from the base rate: no Olympic Games has suffered a mass-casualty attack since Atlanta in 1996, and the 2024 security posture was the largest peacetime deployment in French history. The rail sabotage is the nearest real event and was not at the games. Prayer conditionality is recorded as a field, not used here to convert a non-event into a hit.

evidence.summary: No construction, groundbreaking or formal negotiation toward a third temple on the Temple Mount has occurred. The status quo administered by the Jordanian-funded Jerusalem Islamic Waqf remained in place through 2024, 2025 and into 2026.
evidence.rationale: The 2023 telling attached temple construction to a land division finished by March 2024 and neither happened. The claim has since been re-pointed: February 2026 tellings describe seeing negotiations and groundwork with a horizon out to 2028, which is a new window and not yet due. The record should show the 2024 window closed empty rather than let the later re-pointing absorb it, because rolling the date forward is exactly what the separate windows exist to catch.

evidence.summary: No two-state agreement was reached and the land of Israel was not divided by August 2024 or by the end of 2024. In the week of 21-23 September 2025 the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Portugal and France announced recognition of a Palestinian state around the UN General Assembly high-level week. No third temple construction has begun.
evidence.rationale: Two different windows sit inside this claim. The 2023 one, a two-state deal plus temple construction by March and then by end of 2024, failed outright. The September 2025 one, formal recognitions clustered in the UN week of the 21st to 23rd, landed and was specific about the week. Against it: by 16 September 2025, when he said it, France and the UK had already publicly announced they intended to recognise at that session, so the week was on the calendar. Partial, carried by the 2025 telling and dragged down by the 2023 one.

evidence.summary: Trump's New York criminal trial ran 15 April to 30 May 2024, ending in conviction on all 34 counts; the Supreme Court's immunity ruling in Trump v. United States came on 1 July 2024; the federal and Georgia cases were delayed past the election. On 13 July 2024 he survived an assassination attempt at Butler, Pennsylvania.
evidence.rationale: Said on 9 September 2023, both halves have something. The prosecutions did run into 2024 and became serious, ending in the first felony conviction of a former president. And the vision of praying over Trump's life preceded an actual attempt by ten months. What holds it at partial: when he spoke, four indictments were already filed with 2024 trial dates on the public calendar, so 'the indictments run into the summer' was reading a docket. The November 2024 retelling then adds a claim the record does not support, that the trials were what kept him off the trail and saved his life; he was shot at a campaign rally six weeks after the trial ended.

evidence.summary: On 1 October 2024 Iran fired at least 180 ballistic missiles at Israel, the largest single ballistic missile attack ever recorded; most were intercepted. Rosh Hashanah 2024 fell on 2-4 October. There was no lunar eclipse at Rosh Hashanah 2024; the year's partial lunar eclipse was on 17-18 September 2024.
evidence.rationale: He named 3 October as a turning point on 19 September, and an unprecedented state-on-state missile barrage landed on 1 October, two days early. That is close and it is the reason this is not a miss. Two things weigh against. The blood moon he attaches to Rosh Hashanah is simply not there, which matters because it was offered as the sign. And the escalation was already in motion when he spoke: Israel had begun striking Hezbollah in Lebanon and Iran had publicly threatened retaliation for the Haniyeh killing since July.

evidence.summary: The US economy expanded through the period, with real GDP growth of 2.9 percent in 2023 and 2.8 percent in 2024 and no recession declared. No US economic collapse occurred between autumn 2023 and autumn 2024.
evidence.rationale: The stated content was that no fallout would land on top of us for a year to two years, and it did not. He also marks it in the same breath as an impression rather than prophecy, which is the kind of self-limiting he does rarely and which belongs in the record. But the base rate carries almost all of it: no US recession began, and in any given year the probability of no collapse is far above even. A forecast that the ordinary continues cannot be told apart from silence.

evidence.summary: The NBER dated no US recession beginning in the September 2023 to autumn 2024 window. No single event in that year is identifiable as the unanticipated one described.
evidence.rationale: A season of favour has no threshold, and 'listeners will not be looking for what comes' names nothing. He labels it a feeling rather than a word, which is honest and also removes the last thing that could have failed. Recorded as unfalsifiable rather than credited to him, and kept separate from reprieve-season-2023, which at least carries the checkable no-collapse element.

evidence.summary: The 2024 World Series was New York Yankees against Los Angeles Dodgers, with the Dodgers winning in five games on 30 October 2024. No attack or attempted attack occurred at Yankee Stadium. Within this corpus the earliest recorded mention of the Yankees is 9 October 2024, with further mentions on 22 and 28 October; there is no May 2024 passage naming them.
evidence.rationale: The matchup half is true and the attack half is not. The dating is the problem and it is checkable inside the corpus rather than argued: he says on 4 November that the Lord had been telling him to watch the Yankees since May, but the corpus holds nothing on the Yankees before 9 October, by which date the Yankees were already in the American League Championship Series and the Dodgers in the National League one. A four-team field is a one-in-four matchup at worst, and the whole telling postdates the final game. Partial only because the pre-series prayer passages on 9, 22 and 28 October do exist and do name the team.

evidence.summary: On 13 July 2024 a gunman fired from a roof at the Butler Farm Show grounds in Butler, Pennsylvania, an outdoor Trump campaign rally with a large crowd, wounding Trump in the ear, killing attendee Corey Comperatore and critically injuring two others. A second attempt followed at Trump's West Palm Beach golf course on 15 September 2024. In this corpus the 28 December 2023 passage is the only one before 13 July 2024 that pairs a candidate with an outdoor setting, a big crowd and mountains, and no passage before that date uses the word assassination at all.
evidence.rationale: This is the strongest item scored so far and the corpus check is why. Said 28 December 2023, six and a half months ahead: a presidential candidate needing protection, outdoors, before a big crowd. On 13 July 2024 exactly that configuration produced a shooting. The base rate is genuinely low, an attempt on a US presidential candidate having last occurred in 1972, and it is not boilerplate: the search returns one matching passage before the event and zero uses of assassination, so this is not a standing prayer that eventually caught an event. Two honest deductions. The mountains detail does not fit Butler, which sits in rolling farmland on the Allegheny plateau. And the claim is framed as a prayer request rather than a prediction, which leaves him the reading that prayer prevented the worse outcome. Strong nonetheless, because the falsifiable core, an attempt on a candidate at an outdoor rally, was named in advance and happened.

evidence.summary: Hurricane Helene made landfall on 26 September 2024 as a category 4 storm and killed more than 230 people, the deadliest US mainland hurricane since Katrina. Hurricane Milton made landfall at Siesta Key, Florida on 9 October 2024 as a category 3 storm, causing about 34.4 billion dollars in damage, cutting power to more than three million customers and triggering roughly 150 tornado warnings.
evidence.rationale: He said on 17 August to pray about October because a great storm was coming, and two of the most destructive US hurricanes in twenty years landed either side of the start of that month. The base rate is what stops this being strong: he spoke inside an Atlantic hurricane season that NOAA had already forecast in May as well above normal, and late September to mid-October is the climatological peak. A great storm in October is close to the modal outcome. He also frames the storm as a crisis to be ready for rather than a weather event, so the fit is partly retrospective.

evidence.summary: No significant economic rupture occurred in the United States in October 2024; the S&P 500 fell about 1 percent over the month and continued to new highs afterward. The claim's central assertion concerns proceedings in the courts of heaven and an averted alternative.
evidence.rationale: Two of the three tellings were flagged unfalsifiable by the extractor before any outcome was known, and rightly: hell on earth is offered as the branch that prayer averted, so no observation can bear on it. This is the structure the design flags as prayer conditionality, and it is not being allowed to convert a quiet month into a hit. The one checkable element, a significant economic event in October 2024, did not occur, which cuts against the earlier telling that one would.

evidence.summary: No rapture occurred by October 2024 and no widely reported outbreak of glory demonstrations began in May, June or July 2024.
evidence.rationale: The antecedent he set, demonstrations of glory beginning in early summer, did not occur, and neither did the consequent. He states the six-month window himself and the window closed empty. The conditional framing softens it but does not remove the miss, because both halves failed rather than only the second.

evidence.summary: Biden withdrew on 21 July 2024 and endorsed Harris, who was nominated on 5 August 2024 without a primary contest. Neither Michelle Obama nor Gavin Newsom was on the ticket. The Democratic ticket lost the presidency, the Senate and the House.
evidence.rationale: The shakeup is real and was called in September 2023, well before the June 2024 debate made it conventional wisdom. The two names attached to it were both wrong, and the companion telling that great things were coming for the Democratic Party in 2024 went the other way completely. Scored beside michelle-gavin-2024, which covers the same vision; the mechanism is credited once, not twice.

evidence.summary: The 2024 United States general election was held on schedule on 5 November 2024, with about 156 million ballots cast. There was no disruption, cancellation or postponement, and no attack over the Fourth of July 2024 weekend.
evidence.rationale: He raised it as an open question rather than an assertion, which is the weakest form the claim could take, and even so both halves of the falsifier failed: no Fourth of July attack and no interference with the election. Recorded as contradicted rather than expired because the outcome is the direct negation of what he floated, and because floating the possibility publicly in June 2024 had a cost of its own.

evidence.summary: No cyber or physical attack disabled the United States power grid between August 2024 and the November 2024 election, and no named city suffered a grid attack in that window. Reported grid outages in the period were storm-driven, chiefly Helene and Milton.
evidence.rationale: A bounded window, a named mechanism and named targets, and nothing happened. He introduces it as another person's warning, which under the corpus rule would keep it out of his own claims, but he then says it matches what he has seen and endorses it, so it stays his. The vulnerability articles he cites are a permanent feature of the trade press and support no timing.

evidence.summary: Trump won the 2024 election with 312 electoral votes to Harris's 226, sweeping all seven swing states including Michigan, and also won the national popular vote. The race was called in the early hours of 6 November, within roughly a day of polls closing. In this corpus a 14 July 2024 passage describes a red wave coming out of Michigan and then Oklahoma, four months before the vote.
evidence.rationale: The outcome matched on both checkable points: decisive rather than narrow, and settled overnight rather than over weeks. The Michigan detail he later claims to have called is genuinely in the corpus and predates the election, which is worth recording because that kind of retro claim usually is not. Held at partial for two reasons. The October telling is a prayer declaring a landslide, not a forecast, and it names no candidate, so it could only have been read as fulfilled by whichever side won. And prediction markets had Trump favoured through late October, so a decisive Trump win was not a contrarian call by the time it was said.

evidence.summary: Ted Cruz was re-elected to a third term on 5 November 2024, defeating Colin Allred by roughly 8.5 points, 53.1 percent to 44.6 percent, a wider margin than his 2.6-point win in 2018.
evidence.rationale: The stated outcome occurred. The base rate does nearly all the work and has to be said plainly: Texas has not elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1988, Cruz led every non-partisan poll of the race, and the seat was rated likely or safe Republican by every major forecaster. Praying a red state red is not a call. Recorded so it is not left in the unchecked queue, and scored no higher than partial for that reason.

evidence.summary: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade went ahead on 28 November 2024 with no attack; NYPD reported no credible threat and the only disruption was a protest that led to 21 arrests. No attack occurred at Times Square on New Year's Eve or in Atlanta. In the early hours of 1 January 2025 Shamsud-Din Jabbar drove a truck into New Year's crowds on Bourbon Street in New Orleans, killing 14 and injuring dozens; the FBI called it an act of terrorism.
evidence.rationale: Every venue he named came through clean. What he also said was that attacks on major public gatherings would be the method, and six weeks later a mass-casualty vehicle attack hit a New Year's crowd in a city he did not name. That is the shape without the specifics. Base rate matters here in both directions: DHS bulletins warn about crowded holiday gatherings every year, which is why the general warning is cheap, and the New Orleans attack was the deadliest Islamic State-inspired attack on US soil in years, which is why it is not nothing. Partial, and the named-venue misses are the reason it goes no higher.

evidence.summary: Kamala Harris was elevated to the top of the Democratic ticket on 21 July 2024 without a primary contest, after Biden withdrew. Her running mate was Tim Walz. Harris lost the general election on 5 November 2024 and never became president. No woman was elevated alongside her.
evidence.rationale: The Ford-to-Nixon structure is the interesting part and it half happened: Harris did take the ticket by elevation rather than by an election, which is unusual and which he described fourteen months ahead. Everything attached to it failed. There was no succession to the presidency, the second woman he saw did not appear, the running mate was a man, and his stated reason for the whole thing, that he could not see how the expected 2024 outcome was possible, resolved against him when the expected outcome happened.

evidence.summary: No measured or widely reported change in the operation of charismatic gifts is documented from 25 December 2024. The word originates with Billy Brim on 11 December 2024 and is read on air rather than received by him.
evidence.rationale: A greater level and degree of glory has no observable threshold; nothing could have shown it did not happen. It is also another person's word that he relays, which under the corpus rule is a weaker thing than his own claim, and the record should say so. Recorded as unfalsifiable so it stops counting as unchecked.

evidence.summary: The content is an instruction to the audience to write down what they are believing God for in 2024, together with his household's own list. No outcome is stated.
evidence.rationale: The extractor marked all three tellings not scoreable before any outcome was known and that stands. An instruction is not a claim; there is nothing here that could have come out either way.

evidence.summary: Channel housekeeping: what happens to the channel in his absence, a pointer to his wife's channel, and household goals for 2024 alongside homeschooling.
evidence.rationale: Administrative content with no forward claim. Recorded to clear it from the unchecked queue rather than because there is anything to check.

evidence.summary: Total cryptocurrency market capitalisation roughly doubled over 2024 and gold rose about 27 percent to record highs, while silver rose about 21 percent. No specific instrument is named in the claim.
evidence.rationale: The extractor's own note is exact: unfalsifiable as stated, no instrument named. Certain cryptocurrencies rise and something happens with metals is satisfied in any year with more than one coin and a metal price that moves. That 2024 happened to be a strong year for both is not evidence for a claim that could not have failed.

evidence.summary: The S&P 500 returned about 25 percent including dividends in 2024, its second consecutive year above 20 percent, with 57 record closes. US real GDP grew 2.8 percent and no recession occurred. 2024 also brought two of the deadliest US hurricanes in twenty years and an assassination attempt on a presidential candidate.
evidence.rationale: By the ordinary market and growth measures 2024 was a good year and he said so in August 2023. The device he supplies alongside it is what caps this: a coin you can read either way, good but not good in every aspect, blessed and also bad. With both faces available in advance no outcome could have refuted it, and the extractor recorded exactly that on one telling. Partial for the half that was checkable, and the rationale should be read as saying the claim was built not to fail.

evidence.summary: In fiscal 2024 encounters from Mexico fell 9 percent while encounters from China rose 57 percent, Haiti 16 percent, Cuba 6 percent and Ecuador 5 percent. Overall southwest border encounters fell sharply after the 4 June 2024 presidential proclamation, down more than 60 percent between May and November.
evidence.rationale: Composition moved the way he described, with the Mexican share falling and non-hemispheric arrivals rising. Two deductions. The diversification was already the documented story of fiscal 2023, so describing it in January 2024 was describing the present. And the surge half went the other way: 2024 ended with the sharpest fall in crossings in years, which is the opposite of a surge driven by fear of the next administration.

evidence.summary: Brent crude averaged 80.52 dollars a barrel in 2024 and never traded above about 92 dollars during the year; WTI ranged roughly 62.54 to 81.75 dollars. Neither benchmark has traded above 200 dollars at any point, the all-time high being about 147 dollars in July 2008.
evidence.rationale: A named number on a published series, missed by more than a factor of two, and he repeats it across 2023 and again in June 2025 with gas skyrocketing attached. The mechanism he gave, a secret Saudi agreement with Russia and China, produced no such price. This is the cleanest kind of miss in the database because it needs no interpretation.

evidence.summary: No measurable change in returns to church attendance or in medically documented healings is recorded for 2024 that could be attributed to the declaration.
evidence.rationale: The extractor recorded it at the time as not independently scoreable, and that reading is right. A healing declaration over an unnamed audience has no denominator, so a single testimony confirms it and nothing refutes it.

evidence.summary: The content is an instruction for 2024: meditate on love, be rooted and grounded in love and in the word.
evidence.rationale: An instruction with no outcome attached. Nothing could have shown it false. Recorded to close it out.

evidence.summary: US equities returned about 25 percent in 2024 and the economy grew 2.8 percent, but no large new fiscal or monetary stimulus was enacted: the Federal Reserve was still running quantitative tightening and made its first rate cut only on 18 September 2024. No measurable flourishing of the American church is recorded for 2024; Pew's Religious Landscape Study released in 2025 found the long decline in Christian affiliation had levelled off rather than reversed.
evidence.rationale: He gives three things. A good year, which by market and growth measures it was. Money pumped in to make everything look good, which is wrong on the facts: policy was tightening through most of 2024. And the body of Christ soaring, which has no threshold and did not show up in the affiliation data either way. He also supplies the coin device again, telling listeners the year can be read either way and calling it a choice, and the extractor flagged that telling unfalsifiable on the spot. Partial for the market half only.
